text: Machine learning is a type of technology that helps computers learn from information without being told exactly what to do. One common method is supervised learning, where a computer studies examples called training data. For instance, if you show a computer many photos of cats and dogs, it can learn to tell them apart. From this data, the computer builds models, which are like rules it uses to understand new information. These models then make predictions about things they have never seen before. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy. The more training data a model receives, the better its accuracy often becomes.
